The Railway Recruitment Board (RRB) has issued a notification for the recruitment of Station Master positions under Advertisement Number CEN 08/2026. According to the published details, the recruitment drive aims to fill a total of 1,265 vacancies.

Key Schedule and Important Dates

  • Application Start Date: 27 October 2026
  • Application Last Date: 25 November 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date: 27 November 2026
  • Application Correction Window: 28 November to 07 December 2026
  • Result Declaration Date: Not specified

Eligibility and Application Details

  • Issuing Authority: Railway Recruitment Board (RRB)
  • Notification ID: CEN 08/2026
  • Posts: Station Master
  • Vacancies: 1,265 positions
  • Educational Qualification: Candidates must hold a Bachelor's Degree in any stream from a recognized University in India.
  • Age Limit and Cut-off Date: Age limits and relaxation norms apply as per RRB regulations, with exact parameters detailed in the official notification.

Application Fees and Refund Policy

Payment can be made online using a Debit Card, Credit Card, Internet Banking, IMPS, Cash Card, or Mobile Wallet. The notification notes a fee refund provision where General and OBC candidates receive a Rs. 400 refund, and other eligible candidates receive a Rs. 250 refund credited to their bank accounts after appearing in the Stage I examination.

Selection Stages and Status

  • Selection Stages: Includes a Stage I Exam and subsequent selection phases as per RRB guidelines.
  • Admit Card & Answer Key Status: Not specified.

How to Verify

Applicants are advised to review the official notification thoroughly before submitting their forms. Verification and online applications can be conducted through the official RRB website at rrb.indianrailways.gov.in.
